title: Ambient observability tour — runtime cards & tracing snapshot visuals
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding images and annotated screenshots for the Observability Quickstart flow that highlight runtime health cards, latency heatmaps, cost-per-token breakdowns, and a single-trace waterfall snapshot. These assets will be used across the Console quickstart, product docs, and the marketing one-pager. The goal is to show both macro (dashboard) and micro (trace) levels of observability so new users can understand how to diagnose latency vs cost trade-offs in under 60 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a complete artboard set for the quickstart with 6 final frames: welcome card, latency overview, cost-per-token chart, request distribution scatter, trace waterfall (single request), and routing fallback note
Exported PNGs at 1920x1080 and 2x retina sizes for all frames, with separate cropped variants for hero and thumbnail uses
Each screenshot includes callouts/annotations and copy (max 2 lines) and accessible alt text strings included as a companion CSV
Localized variants produced for EN, DE, and FR (copy approved) and layout verified for length changes
Design handoff notes with exact console routes + synthetic load steps so PM/Eng can reproduce traces for future updates
design_notes: Prefer semantic color tokens from the console design system rather than fixed hex to reduce future churn
Avoid showing real API keys or customer identifiers in mockups; use synthetic traces and obfuscated ids
Latency heatmap should surface p50/p95/p99 bands with tooltip examples; cost chart should show per-token unit and total cost for a sample request
Trace waterfall must show KV cache hits and model variant fallback annotations (these are key product differentiators)
Keep text overlays to two lines max and use 14px/16px sizes for clarity on smaller thumbnails
screenshot_plan: Frame 01 - Onboarding hero: ambient runtime cards (latency, throughput, cost) with spotlight on 'Latency SLO'
Frame 02 - Latency overview: histogram + p50/p95/p99 callouts and small trace preview
Frame 03 - Cost per token: stacked bar for model variants and annotation for quantization impact
Frame 04 - Routing & fallbacks: visual of policy-based routing table and automatic fallback event in timeline
Frame 05 - Trace waterfall: single request trace with KV cache hit markers, kernel-schedule spans, and model-variant switch
Frame 06 - Actionable next steps card: 'Run quickstart load' CTA with exact console route and expected snapshot artifacts
localization_plan: Copy length tests in Figma to ensure UI accommodates German strings (>=20% longer)
Create separate export folders per locale and include alt text CSV for each language

We are avoiding hero animations in the initial release to keep assets lightweight for docs and emails.
If future SLO UI changes land before the release date, we will de-scope the cost-per-token chart and replace with a static KPI tile
